get.summary: Redirect to where content can be retrieved
get.description: Redirects a PieceCID to `/piece/{cid}` on a storage provider serving it, or with `browser=true` to inbrowser.link when the piece has `ipfsRootCID` metadata in an IPFS-indexed data set. Redirects an IPFS root CID to `/ipfs/{cid}` on a provider with a piece whose `ipfsRootCID` metadata matches, or to inbrowser.link with `browser=true`. When no indexed copy exists, `provider` names the provider to redirect to instead. Other query parameters are forwarded.

schema.description: PieceCID v2 or IPFS root CID

parameters.description: PieceCID v2 or IPFS root CID
parameters.name: cid

schema.description: Open IPFS content, or a piece with an IPFS root, in the browser through inbrowser.link

parameters.description: Open IPFS content, or a piece with an IPFS root, in the browser through inbrowser.link
parameters.name: browser

schema.description: Provider ID to redirect to when no indexed copy exists yet, such as a piece the provider has but has not committed on chain

parameters.description: Provider ID to redirect to when no indexed copy exists yet, such as a piece the provider has but has not committed on chain
parameters.name: provider
